action.description: The GitHub audit action, such as org.add_member, repository_ruleset.update or git.clone.

action-category.description: The category prefix in the reported audit action.

actor.description: The GitHub account that performed the action, when reported as a username.

actor-id.description: The reported numeric or textual GitHub actor ID.

actor-is-bot.description: GitHub's reported flag for whether the actor is a bot.

actor-raw.description: The actor field as reported when it cannot be represented as a GitHub username.

application-name.description: The reported name of the app in an integration, installation, or OAuth application event.

created-at-raw.description: The original created_at field, including the source timestamp precision.

default-workflow-permissions.description: The reported default permissions granted to GitHub Actions workflow tokens.

document-id.description: The native audit record identifier from _document_id.

enterprise.description: The reported enterprise slug or name, normally from the business field.

enterprise-id.description: The reported enterprise ID, normally from business_id.

event-kind.description: Whether the action is a Git operation or another GitHub audit event.

event-time.description: The event time in UTC derived from created_at or, when absent, @timestamp.

git-external-id.description: The external identifier reported by GitHub for a Git operation.

github-host.description: The GitHub hostname for this import or the analyst's reported export hostname.

integration.description: The integration identifier or name reported in the audit record.

ip-src.description: The reported actor IP when it is a usable IPv4 or IPv6 address.

oauth-application-id.description: The reported GitHub OAuth application ID.

old-permission.description: The prior permission reported in the audit record.

operation-type.description: The operation type reported by GitHub.

organization.description: The reported GitHub organization, normally from the org field.

permission.description: The GitHub permission reported for the action.

previous-user.description: The prior GitHub username reported in old_user.

previous-user-raw.description: The prior account field when it cannot be represented as a GitHub username.

previous-visibility.description: The prior visibility reported for the repository.

raw-record.description: The complete audit record as JSON. CSV column values are preserved as strings.

raw-record-fragment.description: One JSON-encoded string fragment of a large raw audit record, ordered by the part number in the comment.

repository.description: The repository name reported by GitHub, usually in owner/repository form.

repository-id.description: The reported GitHub repository ID from repo_id or repository_id.

repository-selection.description: The repository selection mode reported for an application installation.

request-id.description: The request ID reported by GitHub.

ruleset-id.description: The ID of the reported repository ruleset.

ruleset-name.description: The name of the reported repository ruleset.

source-address.description: The original actor IP field, which may also contain a provider redaction.

source-country-code.description: The country code from the reported actor location.

target-user.description: The affected GitHub account reported in user or target_login.

target-user-id.description: The reported ID of the affected GitHub account.

target-user-raw.description: The affected account field when it cannot be represented as a GitHub username.

team.description: The team reported in the audit record.

timestamp-raw.description: The original @timestamp field, including the source timestamp precision.

transport.description: The name or code of the transport protocol reported for a Git event.

visibility.description: The visibility reported for the repository.

description: A GitHub organization or enterprise audit log event with its action, actor, scope and reported details.
name: github-audit-event
